tdr_delayed_response.description: Trigger with Delayed Response GF(a & X^n b) (paper Table 2). Paper results are for TDR[6..10]; the hidden test uses unseen delays with renamed atoms, so its absolute numbers differ.

state_count_size_weighted_mean.description: Mean automaton state count per formula, weighted by the formula's size parameter (delay, number of signals, pattern span, or formula length). Computed from the returned automaton.

state_count_per_formula.description: Mean number of automaton states per formula, counted from the returned automaton.

state_count_sum.description: Total number of automaton states over the experiment's formulas (the quantity the paper's tables report).

transition_count_sum.description: Total number of distinct (source, target, accepting) transitions with a satisfiable guard; independent of how guards are split or merged.

semantic_check_pass_rate.description: Agreement of the automaton with the formula's semantics on evaluator-generated, label-balanced ultimately periodic words (including near-miss mutations). Any disagreement fails the run.

generated_trace_pass_rate.description: Agreement on unconstrained dense random ultimately periodic words. Any disagreement fails the run.

planning_value_agreement_rate.description: Fraction of (MDP, start state) pairs on evaluator-generated MDPs where the optimal probability obtained through the MDP x automaton product (agent resolves the automaton's choices online) equals the true optimal satisfaction probability; this is the good-for-MDP requirement. Any disagreement fails the run.

lib_signal_change.description: Liberouter signal-change formulas GF(OR_i (a_i & X !a_i) | (!a_i & X a_i)) (paper Table 2). Paper results are for LIB[6..9]; Slim-Red timed out on LIB[7..9] and is omitted. The hidden test uses other signal counts with renamed atoms.

ncs_ordered_sequence.description: Nested Conjunction Sequence NCS[k1..kn] = GF(a & X^{k1} b & X^{k1+k2} c ...) (paper Appendix N, Table 5, eight rows with GFM-GF sizes 4..11). The extracted Table 5 formulas are garbled; offsets were reconstructed from the visible prefixes (a, X b, X^3 c, ...) and the reported sizes (span + 1). Size weight = span. Slim-Red values are the Table 5 column (sum 1036). Owl-Red is omitted because its last row timed out (finite rows: 8, 16, ..., 512; subtotal 1016 over seven rows).

random_cosafety_gf.description: Headroom experiment (not in the paper): GF(phi) for random co-safety phi over three atoms (operators &, |, X, F, U, negated atoms), generated by the evaluator; the hidden test draws fresh formulas at test time. Size weight = formula length. The paper reports no numbers here; the gfm_gf entry is this reproduction's value on the 16 public formulas of the visible set.
